import hashlib,json,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from arggnn.persistence_trace_kernel_v1 import MetricTreeHoldV1
from arggnn.observed_role_mixed_path_gnn_v1 import (
    ObservedRoleMixedPathGNNV1, prepare_observed_role_mixed_path_bank_v1,
    _unique_role_pairs_v1, _augmented_roles_v1, ObservedRoleMixedPathBankV1)
from arggnn.reference_logcavity_gnn_v1 import prepare_reference_logcavity_bank_v1
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(101)
root=Path("/workspace-SR003.nfs2/ARG-GNN")
source=root/"src/arggnn/observed_role_mixed_path_gnn_v1.py"
receipt=root/"research/reviews/ordered_tree_operator_v1/prototype_receipt.json"
attempt=dict(source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    dtype="float32",device="cpu",fixtures_only=True,model_fit=False,GPU_used=False,
    cuda_context_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized())
start=time.monotonic()
try:
    ages=torch.tensor([0.,0.,100.,150.,400.,450.,200.,250.,500.,600.,900.],dtype=torch.float64)
    p0=torch.tensor([6,7,6,7,9,9,8,8,10,10,-1],dtype=torch.long)
    p1=torch.tensor([7,6,6,7,9,9,8,8,10,10,-1],dtype=torch.long)
    def tree(parent):
        return MetricTreeHoldV1(parent,ages.clone(),torch.full((11,),-1,dtype=torch.long),
            None,torch.arange(6,dtype=torch.long),torch.arange(6,dtype=torch.long))
    a,b=tree(p0),tree(p1)
    intervals=torch.tensor([[0.,1000.],[1000.,2000.]],dtype=torch.float64)
    positions=torch.tensor([250.,750.,1250.,1750.],dtype=torch.float64)
    q=torch.tensor([0,1]);r=torch.tensor([2,3,4,5]);classes=torch.tensor([0,1,2,3])
    def bank(trees,spans=intervals):
        return prepare_observed_role_mixed_path_bank_v1(trees,spans,positions,q,r,classes,
            sample_identity_namespace="handmade_observed_samples")
    changed=bank([a,b])
    identical=bank([a,a])
    model=ObservedRoleMixedPathGNNV1()
    counts={arm:model.parameter_counts(arm) for arm in ("signed_difference","path_sum")}
    assert counts["signed_difference"]==counts["path_sum"]
    frozen=torch.tensor([.4,.3,.2,.1],dtype=torch.float32).log().expand(4,2,4).clone()
    initial=model(changed,frozen,control="signed_difference")
    assert torch.equal(initial,frozen)
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.context_head.weight.normal_(0,.03)
    log_up,log_out=model.log_cavities(changed.reference)
    up,out=model.encode_units(changed.reference,log_up,log_out)
    left,right=model.mixed_paths(changed,up+out,control="signed_difference")
    changed_norm=float(left.norm()+right.norm())
    assert changed_norm>1e-5
    u,o=model.log_cavities(identical.reference)
    u,o=model.encode_units(identical.reference,u,o)
    il,ir=model.mixed_paths(identical,u+o,control="signed_difference")
    zero_norm=float(il.norm()+ir.norm())
    assert zero_norm==0. and identical.metadata["coalesced_holds"]==1
    gradients={}
    outputs={}
    for arm in ("signed_difference","path_sum"):
        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        result=model(changed,frozen,control=arm)
        assert torch.isfinite(result).all()
        result.square().mean().backward()
        trainable={name:p for name,p in model.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad}
        missing=[name for name,p in trainable.items() if p.grad is None]
        assert not missing,missing
        assert all(torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in trainable.values())
        gradients[arm]={name:float(trainable[name].grad.norm()) for name in
            ["path_edge_gate.weight","path_value.weight","context_head.weight","raw_cost","raw_ell"]}
        outputs[arm]=result.detach()
    def permute(t,permutation):
        inverse=torch.empty_like(permutation);inverse[permutation]=torch.arange(len(permutation))
        parent=t.parent[permutation]
        parent=torch.where(parent>=0,inverse[parent.clamp_min(0)],torch.full_like(parent,-1))
        return MetricTreeHoldV1(parent,t.node_times[permutation],t.qualified_node_ids[permutation],
            t.identity_namespace,inverse[t.sample_nodes],t.sample_ids)
    permuted=bank([permute(a,torch.randperm(11)),permute(b,torch.randperm(11))])
    errors={}
    for arm in ("signed_difference","path_sum"):
        other=model(permuted,frozen,control=arm)
        errors[arm]=float((other-outputs[arm]).abs().max())
        assert torch.allclose(other,outputs[arm],rtol=1e-5,atol=1e-6)
    # Direct operator check keeps two identical tiny forests explicitly, while
    # the public preparer correctly coalesces them. No real bank is used.
    pair_ref=prepare_reference_logcavity_bank_v1([a,a],intervals,positions,q,r,classes,
        sample_identity_namespace="handmade_observed_samples")
    keys=_augmented_roles_v1(a,350.,"handmade_observed_samples")
    direct_pairs,_=_unique_role_pairs_v1(keys,keys,0,len(keys))
    ds=torch.tensor([s for s,t in direct_pairs],dtype=torch.long)
    dt=torch.tensor([t for s,t in direct_pairs],dtype=torch.long)
    ec=(pair_ref.forest.parent>=0).nonzero().flatten()
    direct_bank=ObservedRoleMixedPathBankV1(pair_ref,ec,pair_ref.forest.parent[ec],
        ds,dt,dt,ds,{"handmade_uncoalesced_operator_fixture":True})
    arbitrary=torch.arange(len(pair_ref.forest.parent)*16,dtype=torch.float32).reshape(-1,16)/512
    dl,dr=model.mixed_paths(direct_bank,arbitrary,control="signed_difference")
    direct_zero=float(dl.abs().max()+dr.abs().max())
    assert direct_zero==0.
    pairs,ambiguous=_unique_role_pairs_v1(
        [("sample",0),("role",(0,1),"age"),("role",(0,1),"age")],
        [("sample",0),("role",(0,1),"age")])
    assert pairs==[(0,0)] and ambiguous==3
    one=bank([a],torch.tensor([[0.,2000.]],dtype=torch.float64))
    coalesce_error=float((model(identical,frozen,control="signed_difference")-
                          model(one,frozen,control="signed_difference")).abs().max())
    assert coalesce_error==0.
    attempt.update(status="PASS",checks=dict(finite_FP32_gradients=gradients,
        matched_parameter_counts=counts,initial_zero_head_equals_frozen_skip=True,
        changed_topology_signed_path_l2=changed_norm,identical_coalesced_signed_path_l2=zero_norm,
        explicit_identical_pair_signed_path_max_abs=direct_zero,
        node_permutation_max_abs_logits=errors,ambiguous_role_rows_reset=ambiguous,
        identical_hold_coalescing_max_abs_logits=coalesce_error),
        tiny_bank_metadata=changed.metadata,CPU_check_elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
except Exception as error:
    attempt.update(status="FAILED",error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),
        traceback=traceback.format_exc(),CPU_check_elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
data=json.loads(receipt.read_text()) if receipt.exists() else {"schema":"observed_role_mixed_path_gnn_v1_prototype_receipt","attempts":[]}
data["attempts"].append(attempt)
data["latest_status"]=attempt["status"]
data["source"]={"path":str(source.relative_to(root)),"sha256":attempt["source_sha256"]}
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(attempt,indent=2))
if attempt["status"]!="PASS":raise SystemExit(1)
